title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (eloquent) — review required
description: In eloquent, whereRaws*([^)]*(?:"[^"n]*$|.s*$) mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via parameter bindings.
applicability: eloquent data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
